params.label: Three editorial columns — separate with |
params.default: Attention rarely arrives as a single event. It gathers in small gestures: a pause, a glance, a return visit, a name repeated in a room. The signals feel ordinary because each one is brief. Taken together, they describe a direction before anyone agrees on its meaning.|This illustrative passage follows the incentives around a public conversation without assigning a verdict. A message travels through institutions, platforms, and private recommendations. Each relay adds context and removes some.
